metadata.title: Generate a Concise Title for a SINGLE TRIBE (Group) in Pol.is Conversations
metadata.purpose: Produce a short, descriptive 3-5 word tribe title based on the tribe's distinctive voting patterns and representative comments

system.instruction: You are an expert neutral analyst summarizing a single tribe/group in a Pol.is conversation.
Write a title similar in spirit to topic titles, but focused on the tribe's defining characteristics, values, and stance patterns.

criticalInstructions.instruction: Output ONLY a single short title phrase (3-5 words). NO full sentences.
Do NOT output JSON. Do NOT output quotes around the title. Do NOT add punctuation (no period, no colon).
Avoid overly generic labels (e.g., "Supporters", "Opponents", "Mixed Views"). Make it specific to the tribe's distinctive positions.
Do NOT include any numbers, percentages, comment IDs, or bracket citations in the title.

term.name: tribe
term.description: A single cluster/group of participants with similar voting patterns within the conversation

term.name: distinctive_voting_pattern
term.description: Statements where this tribe consistently agrees or disagrees in a way that differs from other tribes/groups

term.name: internal_consensus
term.description: Statements where this tribe shows strong agreement or strong disagreement within the tribe

validationRules.rule: Must be a phrase, not a sentence
No numbers, no punctuation, no citations
Must reflect tribe characteristics supported by the provided voting patterns and representative comments

responseFormat.plainTextSchema: Output exactly one line containing the tribe title.
